title: Langfuse Neon
description: Langfuse v4 metrics from langfuse-prometheus-exporter (all measures, dimensions, score views).

options.content:
LANGFUSE // NEON OPS
LLM TELEMETRY ◆ LANGFUSE METRICS API ◆ ALL 21 MEASURES · 4 VIEWS

panels.title: Langfuse
panels.description: 1 when /api/public/health answers OK.

panels.title: Generations
panels.description: LLM generations, all time.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: All tokens, all time.

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Tool calls that ran, all time (sum over tools).

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Distinct sessions, all time.

panels.title: Traces
panels.description: Distinct traces with a generation, all time.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Generations at level ERROR / all generations, all time.

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: Total cost in USD by Langfuse's model price table.

panels.title: Requests $window
panels.description: Generations in the selected window.

panels.title: Tokens $window
panels.description: Tokens in the selected window.

panels.title: Active sessions $window
panels.description: Distinct sessions in the window.

panels.title: p95 latency $window
panels.description: 95th percentile generation latency in the window.

panels.title: Speed $window
panels.description: Average tokens per second per generation (prompt + output).

panels.title: Prompt cache reuse
panels.description: Cached prompt tokens / all prompt tokens.

panels.title: Reasoning share
panels.description: Reasoning (thinking) tokens / all output tokens.

panels.title: Tool calls / request $window
panels.description: Average tool calls per generation in the window.

panels.title: Generations per minute
panels.description: rate() of the all-time counter, by level.

panels.title: Tokens per minute by type
panels.description: usageByType: fresh prompt, cached prompt, output, reasoning.

panels.title: Tool calls per minute
panels.description: rate() of tool calls, by tool.

panels.title: Observations per minute by type/name
panels.description: Every observation type (GENERATION, SPAN ...).

panels.title: Active sessions and users
panels.description: Distinct sessions / users / traces in each window.

panels.title: Generation latency ($window window)
panels.description: Distribution of generation latency over the window.

panels.title: p50 · 15m
panels.description: Median latency, last 15 minutes.

panels.title: p95 · 1h
panels.description: 95th percentile latency, last hour.

panels.title: p99 · 24h
panels.description: 99th percentile latency, last 24 hours.

panels.title: Latency histogram · 24h
panels.description: Generations per latency band, last 24 h.

panels.title: Average latency (all time, rolling)
panels.description: Δ latency sum / Δ generations: mean latency per request over 5 m, from the all-time counters.

panels.title: Time to first token / streaming latency
panels.description: Only set for streamed generations.

panels.title: Latency stats by window
panels.description: avg / p50 / p95 / p99 / max for 15m, 1h and 24h.

panels.title: Token mix (all time)
panels.description: usageByType: where the tokens went.

panels.title: Tokens per request ($window)
panels.description: Prompt and output tokens per generation (avg, p95).

panels.title: Tokens per second ($window)
panels.description: Throughput per generation (prompt + output) / latency.

panels.title: Prompt size histogram · 24h
panels.description: Generations per prompt-token band.

panels.title: Output size histogram · 24h
panels.description: Generations per output-token band.

panels.title: Speed histogram · 24h
panels.description: Generations per tokens-per-second band.

panels.title: Token counters (all time)
panels.description: Cumulative prompt / output / total tokens.

panels.title: Tokens in window
panels.description: Sum of tokens in 15m / 1h / 24h.

panels.title: Tool calls by tool
panels.description: toolCallInvocations by tool, all time.

panels.title: Generations that called each tool
panels.description: How many generations emitted a call to the tool.

panels.title: Tool calls per request ($window)
panels.description: toolCalls per generation: avg / p95 / max.

panels.title: Tool calls emitted vs run
panels.description: toolCalls (emitted by the model) vs toolCallInvocations.

panels.title: Defined tools / skills / loaded files
panels.description: toolNames, skills and file paths the agent loaded (empty until a client sends them).

panels.title: Top sessions
panels.description: Top 25 sessions by observations (all time).

panels.title: Top users / experiments / gateway keys
panels.description: High-cardinality dimensions, top 25 each (none = not set by the client).

panels.title: By level
panels.description: Observations by level, all time.

panels.title: By type
panels.description: Observations by type, all time.

panels.title: By environment
panels.description: Observations by environment.

panels.title: By model
panels.description: Generations by model.

panels.title: Every low-cardinality dimension
panels.description: Observations per value of trace name, prompt, release, version, tags, root/child, evaluator test, month (none = not set).

panels.title: Tokens per dimension value
panels.description: Tokens per value of the same dimensions.

panels.title: Cost (all time)
panels.description: Input / output / total cost and cost by type, USD.

panels.title: Cost per request ($window)
panels.description: totalCost per generation.

panels.title: Scores
panels.description: Scores of every kind, all time.

panels.description: countScores: scores attached to observations.

panels.title: Scores by name
panels.description: Scores per name and kind (numeric, boolean, categorical).

panels.title: Score values
panels.description: avg / p50 / p95 of numeric and boolean scores; categorical and boolean counts by value.

panels.title: Scrape
panels.description: VictoriaMetrics' scrape of the exporter.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the last refresh without errors.

panels.title: API queries / refresh
panels.description: Metrics API queries per refresh.

panels.title: Query errors
panels.description: Failed queries in the last refresh.

panels.title: Truncated answers
panels.description: Answers that hit the 1000 row limit (all time).

panels.title: Series
panels.description: langfuse_* series scraped.

panels.title: Refresh and scrape time
panels.description: Exporter refresh (all API queries) and the scrape, seconds.
